subject: SOC2 re-attestation: evidence bridge, retention uplift and throughput amendment
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novuscloud.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.example, kimberly_park@redwood.example
Cc: procurement@novuscloud.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: SOC2 re-attestation and renewal — retention + evidence transfer needs

Hi Irene / Kim,

Hope youre well. NovusClouds renewal is coming up and our security team flagged the upcoming SOC 2 re-attestation as part of contract renewal. Two asks surfaced in our internal thread that I wanted to run past you quickly: 

1) Retention uplift: we currently have 90-day audit log retention. For the re-attestation we need to retain a full year (365 days) of selected access and ingestion logs for our Controls scope (attached: Novus_ScopeMatrix.xlsx). Confirm whether Redwood can increase retention for our account and the cost differential.

2) Evidence transfer / audit handoff: our auditor (AuditSuite) needs bulk evidence (snapshots + redacted traces) for the period Jan-Jun 2026. The dataset will be ~120 GB of compressed artifacts. Can you propose an evidence-transfer plan (staging, throughput, checksum verification)? We are concerned about ingest spikes and the impact on our production throughput — if theres a recommended dedicated onramp or temporary throughput increase, please detail.

Attached: AuditQuestionnaire_Q2.pdf (auditor asks) and Scope matrix. Procurement is on CC to start the paperwork once we have a pricing delta.

Timing: wed like to finalize amendments within two weeks to keep the renewal on schedule (renewal due 2026-09-01).

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Head of Security, NovusCloud
ellen.park@novuscloud.com

From: irene_choi@redwood.example <irene_choi@redwood.example>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novuscloud.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example, jonas_weber@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation and renewal — retention + evidence transfer needs

Ellen, thanks for the clear summary — and for the attachments. We can support both requests; below is a practical plan and options so Procurement can scope the amendment.

1) Retention uplift options (per-account):
- Option A: 365-day retention for selected log classes (access + ingestion events) — incremental $0.015 per GB-month; bucketed billing on daily snapshots.
- Option B: 365-day retention + search indexing (adds searchable retention for forensics) — incremental $0.035 per GB-month.
Implementation time: 3 business days after signed addendum + config window (no service restart).

2) Evidence bridge / transfer plan (recommended):
- Stage 1 (bulk ingest): Novus pushes compressed artifacts into our secure transfer endpoint over a 7-day window. We will provision a temporary Dedicated onramp (throughput +20%) for the transfer window to avoid throttling production jobs.
- Stage 2 (verification): checksums + manifest validation; Redwood will perform smoke sampling and index snapshots to the account's evidence bucket.
- Stage 3 (auditor handoff): create read-only archive link for AuditSuite with time-limited access and an integrity report (checksum manifest).
Estimated transfer time: with +20% dedicated throughput, 120 GB compressed -> ~12-18 hours of wall time (parallelized).

3) Commercials & draft terms:
- Throughput pilot (60 days) at +20%: prorated charge ~ $2,200 for the transfer window (one-time) + retention uplift billing going forward (monthly).
- Term amendment: add clause for temporary throughput provisioning and retention exception. Ill attach a short runbook and a term addendum draft to iterate.

Attachments: evidence-transfer-runbook.md (high level steps). Also adding links to a shared folder where we will stage manifests: https://drive.redwood.example/shared/NovusCloud/rd-4729-evidence-bridge

Next steps:
- If Novus agrees to Option A, Procurement can sign the attached DocuSign addendum and we will schedule the transfer week.
- Please confirm a preferred transfer week (we can start as early as 2026-08-24).

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.example
